description: User behavior correction skill. Triggered by "fix:" prefix feedback (e.g., "fix: why didn't you commit?"). Analyzes the mistake, improves the relevant prompt (skill/rule/agent/memory/hook) to prevent recurrence, then fixes the current issue. TodoWrite required for all steps. Use when "fix:", "fix this", "correct", "why not", "why missing", "behavior fix" is mentioned.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
